'''2018 European Championship Day 2 Casper Jørgensen LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casper Jørgensen]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif|label=Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127125624/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
